title: Personal Credit Cards: Rewards Statement Credits Against the Card Balance
content:
Points held on a Personal Credit Cards account can be turned against the debt on that same card, in the form of a statement credit.

## Effect on the card

A cardholder who wants points to reduce the debt on a card has them redeemed as a statement credit posted to the very card that holds them. The credit lowers what the card owes, and the points leave the card's rewards balance, at the same moment. The points applied and the dollar value credited follow the card's rewards terms.

## Performing the redemption

The redemption belongs to the cardholder. After unlocking the customer tool `apply_points_to_card_balance_295c0528`, the agent passes it to the cardholder, and the customer themselves completes the redemption with it. A single run writes the redemption entry for the points given and the matching statement-credit entry for their cash value, and in the same posting takes those points off the card's unredeemed points and that value off its balance owed.

| Field passed | What it carries | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | the card account that supplies the points and takes the credit, as the card account lookup gives it | identifier |
| `reward_points` | points redeemed | whole positive integer, no decimal part |
| `amount` | statement credit applied to the card balance | USD, positive, two decimals rounded half-up |

## Reply to the cardholder's run

A successful run answers with `status` "credited", `redemption_id` for the new redemption entry, `credit_id` for the new statement-credit entry, `card_account_id`, `reward_points`, `amount`, `posted_date`, `new_rewards_balance` (points left) and `new_current_balance` (what the card owes afterwards). The redemption stands once that answer arrives.
